Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Native Chat Tabs (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Two extra tabs inside the original chat window.
Description: Global client testing plugin. Adds two tabs beside the original chat tabs, using the game's own chat-tab appearance. Each extra tab directly selects its message types in /nct; the fourth native log panel remains the rendering slot.
Changelog: 0.1.2.0: Continue Tab 5 and Tab 6 directly after the fourth native tab. Follow the live native font, background dimensions, vertical position and HUD scale after ChatLog updates. Keep native padding, minimum tab width and click bounds; exclude copied unread icons.
